data_fields.name: rotation_overflow_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: if xyz length squared is over 1: normalise xyz, w = 0; else w = sqrt(1 - len_q)

best_idea: Store each unit-quaternion key as three 16-bit fields and rebuild w from the other three (w = sqrt(1 - |xyz|^2)), which is 12 bytes per key against 28 bytes for float32 Vec3 plus Quat, worth a measured test only if clip download size becomes a real problem.
decision_why: Frankendom does not load Gothic clip files, so this decoder adds a second clip format; the w convention is unresolved (the donor's own test expects w = 0.0 for a unit-length sample, TestModelAnimation.cc:16 and 55).
acceptance: If built anyway: a client test decodes one packed clip and checks each bone rotation against the source clip within a stated angle bound; no server test, because animation never decides a kill.
